must_haves: security and where data is stored (Stockholm)

layout.idea: Catalogue index: the page opens with a stacked list of five 'titles' (Connect, Ask, Approve, Teams, Plans), each line linking down to its full section.
layout.why: A visitor sees the whole product in five lines before reading anything, then jumps to what they care about.

hero.idea: Before and after on one sample mailbox: left pane a raw inbox, right pane the same inbox with three AI drafts waiting, labelled 'sample mailbox'.
hero.why: Shows the outcome, not the plumbing.

visual_style.idea: Semantic colour only: brand colours keep their product meaning everywhere (cobalt = action, mint = sent or approved, amber = held, red = blocked), nothing decorative.
visual_style.why: Visitors learn the product's states just by reading the page.

typography.idea: Newsreader 500 italic H1 at 72px, Newsreader 400 body at 19px, Martian Mono 400 at 12px for labels and captions.

narrative.idea: Beliefs: numbered principles (mail is fetched live, you approve sends, your provider stays the source of truth) each backed by a link to how it works.
narrative.why: A clear point of view on agents and email.

proof.idea: A 'Works with' wall of supported providers and clients, each linking to its setup guide; labelled as compatibility, never 'trusted by'.
proof.why: Real, checkable, and it answers fit.

asset_use.idea: Clips that play only on hover or focus, with a still poster frame by default.

motion.idea: One looping hero clip that pauses when off screen, with visible pause control.
motion.why: Motion where it explains, nowhere else.

section_order.idea: Hero > Spec sheet > Fig. 1 dashboard > Fig. 2 draft card > Fig. 3 connect screens > Pricing table > Footnotes

voice.idea: Plain manual voice. Sample: 'Connect an inbox. Paste one URL. Ask.'
voice.why: Short instructions match a short setup.

wildcard.idea: Footnotes for every claim: superscript numbers link to the docs or changelog entry that proves it.
